args: go2rtc --version     && pip3 install --no-cache-dir "uv==$(awk -F'==' '/^uv==/{print $2}' homeassistant/requirements.txt)"     && uv pip install         --no-build         -r homeassistant/requirements.txt

if ls homeassistant/home_assistant_*.whl 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then         uv pip install homeassistant/home_assistant_*.whl;     fi     && uv pip install         --no-build         -r homeassistant/requirements_all.txt
uv pip install         -e ./homeassistant     && python3 -m compileall         homeassistant/homeassistant

organization.description: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first. Powered by a worldwide community of tinkerers and DIY enthusiasts.

release.body:
- Fix Proxmox VE update version detection ([@ezaekiel] - [#184823]) ([proxmoxve docs])
- Fix duplicate access events in UniFi Access integration ([@imhotep] - [#185160]) ([unifi_access docs])
- Handle missing Omada controller update fields ([@rubempoli] - [#185164]) ([tplink_omada docs])
- Bump wheels and base image to 2026.10.0 ([@agners] - [#185227]) (dependency)
- Upgrade runner to Ubuntu 26.04 ([@edenhaus] - [#186424])
- Bump Python to 3.14.8 ([@edenhaus] - [#186429]) (dependency)
- Create new SSL context instead of sharing context in SMTP integration ([@tr4nt0r] - [#186812]) ([smtp docs])
- Update uv to 0.12.24 (@renovate] - [#186899]) (dependency)
- Fix missing EnergyZero gas prices before 06:00 ([@klaasnicolaas] - [#186917]) ([energyzero docs])
- Bump opower to 0.22.3 ([@tronikos] - [#186928]) ([opower docs]) (dependency)
- Update uv to 0.13.0 (@renovate - [#186930]) (dependency)
- Handle errors in Synology DSM button press actions ([@mib1185] - [#186931]) ([synology_dsm docs])
- Hold off the bootstrap timeout while the KNX telegram store initializes ([@farmio] - [#186980]) ([knx docs])
- Constrain bitstring<5 to fix edl21 (pysml incompatibility) ([@SchmidSP] - [#186985])
- Fix Sensibo full_state action modifying the coordinator data ([@DeviousCardi] - [#187014]) ([sensibo docs])
- Correct the mix-ed up lock and device lock FRITZ!SmartHome sensors ([@mib1185] - [#187119]) ([fritzbox docs])
- Fix Home Connect event listener stopping on token refresh errors ([@nikslim] - [#187207]) ([home_connect docs])
- Bump blebox-uniapi to v2.5.8 ([@bkobus-bbx] - [#183968]) ([blebox docs]) (dependency)
- Bump blebox-uniapi to v2.5.9 ([@bkobus-bbx] - [#187300]) ([blebox docs]) (dependency)
- Fix holiday category selector translations ([@gjohansson-ST] - [#187606]) ([holiday docs])
- Bump pyhive-integration to 1.0.10 ([@KJonline] - [#187610]) ([hive docs]) (dependency)
- Update uv to 0.13.4 ([@edenhaus] - [#187742]) (dependency)
- Bump pynina to 1.0.4 ([@DeerMaximum] - [#187868]) ([nina docs]) (dependency)
- Bump victron-vrm to 0.1.14 ([@AndyTempel] - [#188016]) ([victron_remote_monitoring docs]) (dependency)
- Bump base image to 2026.10.1 ([@edenhaus] - [#188204]) (dependency)
- Update frontend to 20260930.5 ([@bramkragten] - [#188206]) ([frontend docs]) (dependency)
- Update uv to 0.13.5 (@renovate - [#188208]) (dependency)
